name: drop-note
short: Email anything to one address. AI summarizes and tags it, and you browse it all in a clean dashboard.

images.alt: drop-note landing page: Save anything from anywhere
drop-note items dashboard with AI summaries and tags

highlights: One address, drop@dropnote.me, saves articles, links, PDFs and notes
AI writes a summary and tags for every item in seconds
Envelopes turn saved items into a plan you can tick off
Own design system, Airmail, in light and dark
next: Friend beta: collect feedback on Envelopes and the Mood Sheet
Production hardening: uptime monitoring and alerting
Morning Post: an optional daily digest of saved items

plan.now: Envelopes shipped: a daily idea pool and the Mood Sheet. Friends are testing the beta.

weeks.goal: Ship Envelopes: idea pool and Mood Sheet
Collect beta feedback on Envelopes and the Mood Sheet
Production hardening: uptime monitoring and alerting
Draft Morning Post, an optional daily digest

timeline.title: Envelopes: Mood Sheet and daily idea pool
timeline.body: Pick a mood and get a plan built from your own saved items. Also fixed search for Chinese queries.

timeline.title: Mobile pass: 15 fixes in 2 days
timeline.body: 44px tap targets everywhere, iOS double-scroll fixed, admin tables usable on phones.

timeline.title: Envelopes v1: turn saved items into plans
timeline.body: Select items, generate an editable plan, tick lines off, regenerate with edits.

timeline.title: Airmail redesign; dropped Redis
timeline.body: Adopted a postal-themed design system. Moved rate limits into Postgres, removing a paid service.

timeline.title: Handed engineering to an AI agent team
timeline.body: Agents work tickets in isolated branches. I review and merge.

timeline.title: Alpha complete; went hosted-only
timeline.body: All planned features shipped. Dropped the open-source plan to focus on one hosted product.

timeline.title: First commit
timeline.body: Monorepo, database schema with row-level security, and Google sign-in on day one.
